description: On the E046 tip (or on the static-shape tip if it is banked first), lower the LR floor of the Muon groups only (9 conv filter groups plus the head) from 0.07x to 0.05x of peak. Keep the SGD groups' floor, the warmup, the peak LR and the EMA/lookahead unchanged. Pass the value as the existing 0-d tensor schedule so nothing recompiles.
